label: What a database records
subgoals: List the configurable features of each tile type
Record each feature's bit offsets relative to the tile base
Map tile instances to their base addresses

label: Fuzzing
subgoals: Build designs that differ in one controlled feature
Diff the bitstreams across many such designs
Keep the bits that track the feature consistently

label: Limits and uses
subgoals: Validate the database against known-good bitstreams
Decode bitstreams back into netlists for checking
Build synthesis first for undocumented families
